items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Everything, once I discovered him, I wouldn’t let him out of my sight.

ctx.x: So what else did you use Joe on besides, Ring-a-Ding-Ding!
Everything, once I discovered him, I wouldn’t let him out of my sight.
He was kind of for you what Art Pepper was for Marty Paich.
